services.name: Campus Programs
services.desc: On-campus program fees typically include instructional costs, meals, and program materials. Lodging is not included in the program fee. We encourage seminar and virtual book club participants to purchase their books from local book sellers or borrow from a local library. For summer programs, W&L reserves a limited number of dormitory-style rooms on campus. These accommodations include two twin beds, shared gender-specific hall bathrooms and showers, kitchen and laundry facilities, and a common sitting area. All on-campus lodging offers Wi-Fi and is within a short walk of free parking. The residence halls are about a five-minute walk from the main campus, where most programming takes place.
